The offer

Take a token. Get on the list.

The First 100 Guest List

Register your interest now and we hold your place in line. When dates and booking open, the First 100 hear first.

Why take it? Because The Green Dictate is a small 50-seat room, and the only way to be sure you hear about opening is to be on the list.

Register for Early Access
  • First notice. You hear exact opening dates and booking details before the public does.
  • Your Citizen Card. A personal card, generated the moment you register, ready to save and share.
  • A say in Rule Four. Guests propose one operating rule a month; the First 100 are invited to suggest one.

Registering is free and does not reserve a table. Booking details are sent to the First 100 first.

Who it's for

The Conscious Explorer

This summons is for people in Delhi NCR who love a hidden-door dinner but are tired of sustainability claims they can't check.

🍽️

Food-curious diners

Urban professionals and couples, roughly 25 to 40, who choose places by story and word of mouth.

🌿

Sustainability sceptics

You care, but you distrust green branding. You want proof on the plate, not a logo on the wall.

🎟️

Teams & creators

Companies planning team dinners, and creators who hunt down hidden venues worth a story.

Why it's worth it

Most restaurants ask you to believe them.
We let you see.

📍

The Radius

Every dish shows how far its ingredients travelled, down to the kilometre.

♻️

Circular kitchen

Stems, peels, whey and day-old bread become the dish. Surplus is cooked first.

🧾

Compliance Receipt

You leave with a record of the kilos rescued and local spend your evening supported.

⚖️

Rule Four

One guest-proposed rule becomes law every month. A dictatorship you can vote into.

The signature experience

The 2029 Table

A shared five-course dinner. Each course arrives with a Decree Card showing its source, its Radius and the waste-saving decision behind it. Priced at INR 1,450 per guest.

Stalk & LeafCauliflower leaves and broccoli stems in a besan crust.
Second-day KulchaApproved bakery surplus, reborn beside whey dal.
The Mandi MainSeasonal, local, cooked from what the market offered today.
Whey VerdictWhey turned into chaach, chaas raita and chhena poda.
Zero-waste HalwaBread and jaggery, finished with candied citrus peel.

Questions

Frequently filed

Is this a table booking?

Not yet. Joining the guest list registers your interest and does not reserve a table. We will email the First 100 the exact dates and how to book before the public hears.

Does it cost anything?

Registering is free and no payment is taken.

When does it open?

We are opening in January 2027. The exact opening dates are emailed to the First 100 first.

Is The Green Dictate a real restaurant?

It is a student restaurant concept created for the Hospitality Pro League 2026–27 (Group 3, Sustainable Hospitality), and not an operating restaurant at this time.

What happens to my email?

It is used only to send you the launch confirmation and updates you signed up for. Reply "Unsubscribe" to any email to be removed.
